headlines.title: What is postpartum psychosis? The mental health condition is at the center of the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s lawyers say a rare mental health condition caused her to kill her three children. So what is postpartum psychosis, and why is it so difficult to diagnose and treat? NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: Rabbi Shares Tips for Navigating Unexpected Challenges
headlines.description: Rabbi Rachel Ain of Sutton Place Synagogue in New York City joins TODAY to talk about the lessons from her upcoming book “Watch How You Go.” She discusses why you should zoom out when you have a stressful day, how to recognize signs that it's time to let go of one priority to focus on another, and more.

headlines.title: What’s Behind the Booming Business of Men’s Grooming?
headlines.description: Sales of men’s grooming supplies topped a whopping $7 billion in 2025, according to research firm NIQ, and it’s a trend that’s only growing as social media and video calls make people pay more attention to how they look. NBC’s chief consumer correspondent Vicky Nguyen reports for TODAY on how more men are exploring skin care and cosmetic treatments.

headlines.title: CDC investigates cases of salmonella and E.coli linked to alfalfa sprouts
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is investigating dozens of cases of salmonella and E.coli linked to alfalfa sprouts. The cases were concentrated in the Midwest, with two people infected with both salmonella and E.coli at the same time.

headlines.title: Avoid making plantar fasciitis pain worse with these sneakers
headlines.description: Podiatrists recommend the best sneakers for plantar fasciitis that have arch support, shock absorption and rigidity, with expert tips for treating foot pain.

headlines.title: Should you stop using your hands to apply your skin care? We asked a dermatologist
headlines.description: Wondering if using your fingers to apply skin care spreads bacteria? A board-certified dermatologist explains, plus the best hands-free skin care products to try.

headlines.title: This popular rolling duffel bag ‘holds 4 days of clothes for 3 people’ — it’s under $30 today
headlines.description: Looking for a duffel that packs a week’s worth of clothes? See why the Rockland Rolling Duffel Bag is a smart, budget-friendly pick for your next trip.

headlines.title: Vuori, Alo, and other stylish running gear is up to 53% off just in time for fall marathons
headlines.description: From cushioned shoes to versatile layers, this running gear will help you through all of your fall jobs and long runs — plus, it’s on sale for up to 53 percent off.

headlines.title: Alfalfa sprouts recalled for E. coli and salmonella after dozens of illnesses in 15 states
headlines.description: Health officials are warning consumers not to eat certain brands of alfalfa sprouts that have been linked to an unusual outbreak involving different disease-causing bacteria.

headlines.title: Eye drops recalled over possible contamination, FDA reports
headlines.description: The FDA reported that bottles of Clear Eyes Maximum Itchy Eye Relief have been recalled over potential contamination.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to tainted jalapenos isn’t over, as CDC reports more than 400 cases
headlines.description: The CDC reported more than 400 cases in 32 states, although the number of illnesses is likely to be much higher.
